Google Cloud Platform • Cloud provider (Google Cloud Platform, Looker, Gemini AI, Vertex API)

1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, California, United States.

For cloud compute and storage (Google Cloud Platform), personal data stored includes name, usernames, email addresses, and phone numbers (for some products) of customers with accounts in our system. Looker may cache personal data for performance reasons including name, username, email address, IP address. For Gemini AI and Vertex API, used in customer support chatbot and natural language data query service, and data analysis, personal data may include username, email, IP address, device id, and any personal data submitted by the user in queries. No inputs may be used by Google to train or improve its artificial intelligence models.

### Sauce Labs Achieves ISO/IEC 42001 Certification for AI

Published July 21, 2026

Sauce Labs has achieved ISO/IEC 42001 certification, the international standard for the responsible management of artificial intelligence. This makes Sauce Labs the first dedicated software quality platform to bring its AI capabilities under a fully certified AI Management System.

The certification applies to the AI Management System (AIMS) supporting the development, deployment, and maintenance of the Sauce AI product line.

Customers and prospects can review the full certificate and supporting compliance documentation on the Sauce Labs Trust Center at [trust.saucelabs.com/resources](https://trust.saucelabs.com/) Opens in new tab

[See our full press release here.](https://trust.saucelabs.com/resources?s=yshc9ovdlou4yx7k1fxfhp&name=sauce-labs-achieves-iso-42001-certification-%E2%80%94-press-release) Opens in new tab
